welcome.subtitle:
Train. Earn drops.
Redeem them for rewards at the gym.
welcome.slide1Body: Every rep counts. Earn drops for every workout and redeem them for real rewards at your gym.
welcome.slide2Body: Scan the QR code on any machine → Train at your pace → Earn drops automatically → Redeem for rewards.
welcome.slide3Body: SweatDrop is launching at select partner gyms. Be among the first to join the drops revolution.

stepper.title: How it works
stepper.subtitle: Three steps to rewards
stepper.step1Desc: Every workout on a machine earns you Sweat Drops — the longer you train, the more drops you collect.
stepper.step2Desc: Complete challenges, earn badges, and climb the leaderboard at your gym.
stepper.step3Desc: Exchange your drops for protein, merch, and discounts at the front desk.
